**End Time**

Simulation finish time in hours, after the start time.

**Syntax:** `End Time == <time_in_hours>`

**Verified examples:**
- End Time == 12
- End Time == 48

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/80-AppendicesA-TCFCommands.html)

contexts.hover:
**Read GIS Z Shape**

Modify Zpts from a vector 2d_zsh layer.

**Syntax:** `Read GIS Z Shape == <gis_layer>`

**Verified examples:**
- Read GIS Z Shape == ..\model\gis\2d_zsh.shp
- Read GIS Z Shape RIDGE == ..\model\gis\2d_zsh.shp
- Read GIS Z Shape GULLY == ..\model\gis\2d_zsh.shp

**Notes:** Uses vector points, lines and polygons; never a TIF/ASC raster. RIDGE, GULLY and XF switches modify the left-hand command.

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/82-AppendicesC-TGCCommands.html)

**BC Database**

Select the active boundary-condition CSV database.

**Syntax:** `BC Database == <.csv_file>`

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/83-AppendicesD-TBCCommands.html)

**AD Approach**

Choose the 1D advection-dispersion approach.

**Syntax:** `AD Approach == METHOD A | {METHOD B}`

**Documented values:** METHOD A, METHOD B

**Verified examples:**
- AD Approach == METHOD A
- AD Approach == METHOD B

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/81-AppendicesB-ECFCommands.html)

**RF Interpolation Method**

Select rainfall interpolation algorithm.

**Syntax:** `RF Interpolation Method == IDW | POLYGON | TIN`

**Documented values:** IDW, POLYGON, TIN

**Verified examples:**
- RF Interpolation Method == IDW
- RF Interpolation Method == POLYGON
- RF Interpolation Method == TIN

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/85-AppendicesF-TRFCCommands.html)

**Base Cell Size**

Define the Level 1 quadtree cell size or inherit from TGC.

**Syntax:** `Base Cell Size == <cell_size> | {TGC}`

**Documented values:** TGC

**Verified examples:**
- Base Cell Size == TGC

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/87-AppendicesH-QCFCommands.html)

**End Time**

Simulation finish time in hours, after the start time.

**Syntax:** `End Time == <time_in_hours>`

**Verified examples:**
- End Time == 12
- End Time == 48

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/80-AppendicesA-TCFCommands.html)

**Timestep**

Classic fixed timestep or HPC starting timestep, in seconds.

**Syntax:** `Timestep == <timestep_in_seconds>`

**Verified examples:**
- Timestep == 1
- Timestep == 0.5

**Notes:** HPC subsequently uses adaptive timestepping.

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/80-AppendicesA-TCFCommands.html)

**Origin**

Set geographic origin at the lower-left grid corner.

**Syntax:** `Origin == <OX>, <OY>`

**Verified examples:**
- Origin == 500000, 6500000

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/82-AppendicesC-TGCCommands.html)

**BC Event Source**

Associate an event placeholder with a boundary-event name.

**Syntax:** `BC Event Source == <bc_event_text> | <bc_event_name>`

[Official TUFLOW documentation](https://docs.tuflow.com/classic-hpc/manual/2026.3/83-AppendicesD-TBCCommands.html)
